# Merck Animal Health USA

> > Merck Animal Health USA provides comprehensive veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and digital health solutions across companion animals, livestock, poultry, equine, and aquaculture markets.

Merck Animal Health USA is a leading provider of innovative animal health products including vaccines, therapeutics, parasiticides, and monitoring technologies. The portfolio features advanced formulations like JAK inhibitors for dermatitis, RNA particle technology vaccines, and digital livestock monitoring systems serving veterinary professionals, producers, and pet owners.

## Key Topics

- JAK inhibitor therapy
- RNA particle technology
- Atinvicitinib
- Canine dermatitis treatment
- Livestock identification
- Bovine respiratory disease
- Companion animal vaccines
- Livestock monitoring
- Parasite prevention
- Equine health
- Swine vaccines
- Poultry vaccines
- Veterinary therapeutics
- Animal health technology
- FDA-approved products

## Featured Products & Innovations

- [Numelvi (atinvicitinib tablets)](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/numelvi/about-numelvi): JAK inhibitor for canine dermatitis treatment - a new therapeutic approach for dogs
- [Bravecto](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/bravecto): Extended-duration flea and tick protection for dogs and cats
- [SenseHub Monitoring](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/sensehub): Digital livestock monitoring technology for dairy, feedlot, and cow-calf operations
- [RESFLOR GOLD](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/products/resflor-gold): Treatment for bovine respiratory disease in cattle
- [Allflex](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/allflex): Livestock identification and electronic ID ear tag solutions

## Vaccine Portfolio

- [NOBIVAC](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/nobivac): Companion animal vaccines using RNA particle technology
- [Bovilis](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/bovilis): Cattle vaccines for respiratory, clostridial, and reproductive health
- [Innovax](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/innovax): Poultry vaccines using HVT construct technology
- [SEQUIVITY](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/sequivity): Custom swine vaccines using RNA particle technology
- [PRESTIGE Equine Vaccines](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/prestige): Equine vaccines for influenza, rabies, and West Nile virus

## Parasite Prevention & Therapeutics

- [SENTINEL](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/sentinel): Parasite prevention for canines with flea and worm control
- [SAFE-GUARD](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/safe-guard): Fenbendazole dewormer for livestock parasite control
- [Vetsulin](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/hub/vetsulin): Insulin for diabetes management in dogs and cats
- [REVALOR-200](https://www.merck-animal-health-usa.com/products/revalor-200): Cattle implant for growth promotion and feed efficiency
